configurations._comment: next start, for checking a public page the way a reader gets it. next dev does NOT hydrate under an agent browser pane (its CSP blocks the eval() dev-mode React needs), so a dev server cannot verify an interactive control. Deliberately carries no env: `next start` sets NODE_ENV=production, where isLocalDevAuthEnabled() and isPublicDemoEnabled() both refuse by construction — the flags would be inert, and an inert flag in a config reads as an enabled one. Signed-in routes therefore 307 to WorkOS here; this entry is for /repository, /pricing and the rest of the public site.
configurations.name: web-prod

configurations._comment: web-prod, but built into .next-prod-agent on its own port so it cannot collide with a `next dev` another session is already running in this folder (the two share .next and clobber each other). It must also not share .next-agent with the `web-agent` dev profile above, for the same reason: `next dev` and `next start` in one dist dir clobber each other's cache and output. Build first: NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-prod-agent pnpm --filter @majorana/web build. Same reason as web-prod for using `next start` over `next dev`: dev-mode React needs eval(), which the agent browser pane's CSP blocks, so an interactive control cannot be verified on a dev server.
configurations.name: web-prod-agent
